assertions: A full Ready baseline and durable completion facts precede desired B with partition=2
Actual failed Pod disappears, survivor DELETE is rejected, and recovery completion facts are cleared before restart
Restart changes controller UID without changing image or template, and completes initialSync
partition 2->1 while stopped; missing low unit consumes maxUnavailable=1; healthy survivor and other unit UIDs stay unchanged while POST is blocked
First replacement uses historical A, a new UID and the applied entry/worker layout; surviving healthy UIDs remain until partition release
High eligible unit reaches B only after refill; partition 1->0 then converges all eligible units to B
A fresh fault in the continuously running controller still replaces exactly the configured Role/SG scope
limitations: This suite does not migrate the 84 historical recovery cases or prove every roleCoordination/maxSkew/order combination
Pure NotReady, None, grace=-1 and finite grace retain their independent recovery-contract/grace-restart coverage
RUN-436/439 remain the separate rolling-Terminating restart cases
